function: Excluded, above_phy: the DRL agent allocates uplink and downlink bandwidth and MEC computing resources to collaborative sensing tasks, an edge-computing and scheduling decision above the physical layer (p. 5).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 5, Section III-A: the action space is "uplink bandwidth", "MEC server computing resource", and "downlink bandwidth", and the goal is to maximize the completion rate of collaborative sensing tasks (waiting and execution queues, p. 4). Transmit powers are fixed at 27 and 30 dBm (p. 8) and sensing data are assumed already collected (p. 3); no beam, precoder, waveform, detector, or channel estimator is learned, and no antenna array or RIS is modeled. Area 5 (ISAC) was considered and rejected: no sensing waveform, beam, or radar resource is learned. If the reviewer reads the bandwidth allocation as a radio decision, the next code in the order would be function.
